trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read of tbl:hecke-operations-table1-data (legend, 12-row table, notation paragraph). VERIFIED EVERY ROW symbolically in H_3(q) with h = q - 1/q: sigma_0^2 = 1 + h sigma_0; sigma_0 sigma_1^2 = sigma_0 + h L+; sigma_1 sigma_0^2 = sigma_1 + h L-; sigma_0^2 sigma_1 = sigma_1 + h L+; sigma_0 sigma_1 sigma_0 sigma_1 = L- + h e- (via the braid relation); sigma_1 sigma_0 sigma_1 sigma_0 = L+ + h e-; sigma_0^-1 = sigma_0 - h gamma; sigma_0^-1 sigma_1^-1 = L+ - h sigma_0 - h sigma_1 + h^2 gamma. All twelve normal forms and all twelve net(q_0) values are correct (nets 1+h = 1.209, 1-h = 0.791, 1-2h+h^2 = 0.6256 -> 0.626, and 0.451).
trap-negation-contrast.notes: Cat.3: the two spaced dashes are a true apposition naming the net(q_0) column, single instance - pass. Cat.1: 'are numeric coefficients in the Hecke normal form, not separate symbols' is load-bearing disambiguation preventing a real misreading of 0.044/0.209 as symbols, stated directly rather than narrated - the documented false-positive class.
